replacement_request.generation_project_description:
The project aims to develop a Hospital Management System designed to organize and optimize resources within a public health system. The system addresses the challenge of managing a large and complex public health infrastructure, such as Brazil's Unified Health System (SUS), by providing a tool to prevent waste and maximize resource utilization, particularly in patient care.The system manages hospitals, each equipped with an inventory of various products, including a blood bank, and a specific number of beds. Its core functionalities include registering hospitals, recommending the closest hospital with available beds to a patient based on their location, and facilitating patient check-in and check-out processes. It also allows users to monitor available beds, register and manage product quantities in hospital stock, and oversee blood bank resources.
